# UIStroke

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIStroke")`

An outline on its parent's text or border (ADR 0110). On a text object it outlines the text unless `ApplyStrokeMode` says `Border`; on anything else, the border. A `UIGradient` under it colours the stroke. Several border strokes may share an element, ordered by `ZIndex`; a text object takes one text stroke. A stroke never changes the layout, so an outer one can overlap a neighbour.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

| `ApplyStrokeMode` | `Enum.ApplyStrokeMode` | `Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual` | read/write | `Contextual` outlines the text of a text object and the border of anything else; `Border` always outlines the border. |
| `BorderOffset` | `UDim` | `UDim.new(0, 0)` | read/write | Moves a border stroke outwards (inwards when negative). Scale is a fraction of the parent's shorter side. Text strokes ignore it. |
| `BorderStrokePosition` | `Enum.BorderStrokePosition` | `Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Outer` | read/write | Where on the border a border stroke lies: wholly outside it, centred on it, or wholly inside. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The stroke's colour. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Off draws nothing. |
| `LineJoinMode` | `Enum.LineJoinMode` | `Enum.LineJoinMode.Round` | read/write | How a corner is turned: rounded, cut off, or brought to a point. A `UICorner` on the parent makes a border stroke round whatever this says. |
| `StrokeSizingMode` | `Enum.StrokeSizingMode` | `Enum.StrokeSizingMode.FixedSize` | read/write | Whether `Thickness` is pixels or a fraction of the parent. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `1` | read/write | Pixels, or with `StrokeSizingMode.ScaledSize` a fraction of the parent's shorter side (of the font size, on text). Animating it on text makes a new outline for every size it passes through, so prefer a fixed one there. |
| `Transparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The stroke's own see-through, apart from its parent's: a stroke on text whose `TextTransparency` is 1 is hollow lettering. |
| `ZIndex` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The order among the element's strokes: lower draws behind higher, and equal ones draw in child order. |
